info.name: Amazon AppFlow Connectors Flows API
info.description:
Amazon AppFlow is a fully managed integration service that enables you to securely transfer data between SaaS applications like Salesforce, SAP, Zendesk, Slack, and ServiceNow, and AWS services like Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift. You can run data flows at enterprise scale at the frequency you choose — on a schedule, in response to a business event, or on demand.

Contact Support:
 Name: AWS Support
